function_v0.doc:
Deploy-time initialisation.  Must be called exactly once.

* `admin`        \xe2\x80\x94 address that can call admin-only functions.
* `reward_token` \xe2\x80\x94 SEP-41 contract address for Zi (the reward currency).
* `lp_token`     \xe2\x80\x94 SEP-41 LP token contract address stakers must deposit.
Can be updated later by the admin via `set_lp_token()`.
function_v0.name: init

function_v0.doc: Claim all pending Zi rewards without unstaking.  Can be called at any\ntime, regardless of the lock status.
function_v0.name: claim

function_v0.doc:
Stake `amount` LP tokens.  Starts (or extends) a 1-year hard lock.

If the staker already has an active position, the new tokens are added
and the lock is reset to `now + 1 year` from the new deposit time.
Rewards already accrued up to this point are snapshotted into
`pending_rewards`.
function_v0.name: stake

function_v0.doc: Withdraw all staked LP tokens.  Reverts if the 1-year lock has not\nexpired.  Automatically claims any pending Zi rewards.
function_v0.name: unstake

function_v0.doc: Returns the configured LP token address.
function_v0.name: lp_token

function_v0.doc: Pause the contract \xe2\x80\x94 blocks stake / unstake / claim.  Admin only.
function_v0.name: set_paused

function_v0.doc: Returns the current reward rate (Zi stroops per second).
function_v0.name: reward_rate

function_v0.doc: Returns the staker's current position: (staked, unlock_time, pending_rewards).
function_v0.name: staker_info

function_v0.doc:
Deposit Zi into the reward pool.  Can be called by **any** account
(G-address or Soroban contract address) at any time.

When called:
1. Transfers `amount` Zi from `funder` to this contract.
2. If there is an active reward period with remaining rewards, those
remaining rewards roll forward into the new period budget.
3. Recalculates `reward_rate` = total_budget / SECONDS_PER_YEAR.
4. Sets `period_finish` = now + SECONDS_PER_YEAR.

The 10% APR target is achieved by the caller depositing 10% of the
total staked LP value in Zi per year.  The contract does not enforce
the 10% figure \xe2\x80\x94 it emits whatever rate the pool can sustain.
function_v0.name: fund_rewards

function_v0.doc: Returns the configured reward token address.
function_v0.name: reward_token

function_v0.doc: Update the LP token address the contract accepts for staking.\nAdmin only.  Existing stakers are unaffected \xe2\x80\x94 their positions remain\nvalid under the old token; only new stakes use the new address.
function_v0.name: set_lp_token

function_v0.doc: Returns total LP tokens staked across all accounts.
function_v0.name: total_staked

function_v0.doc: Returns the timestamp when the current reward period ends.
function_v0.name: period_finish

function_v0.doc: Transfer the admin role to a new address.
function_v0.name: transfer_admin

function_v0.doc: Returns the current pending rewards for a staker (without mutating state).
function_v0.name: pending_rewards
